description: Read-only security audit of 6 microservices producing structured AUDIT_REPORT.json covering 12 CWE findings

steps.send: Perform a read-only security audit of all 6 microservices under `services/` (`gateway`, `payments`, `uploads`, `search`, `webhooks`, `admin`). Do NOT modify any file under `services/`. Write a structured JSON report to `AUDIT_REPORT.json` at the repository root with schema `{"findings": [{"service": "...", "file": "...", "line": 123, "cwe": "CWE-...", "severity": "critical|high|medium", "summary": "...", "remediation": "..."}]}` covering every concrete vulnerability across all 6 services with exact file paths, line numbers, and CWE IDs.
